key_findings: Request submitted, slot held, waitlisted, calendar-created, and confirmed booked are distinct states and must not be collapsed.
BenefitFlow beta has strong pre-transaction approval controls but lacks a post-handoff external booking lifecycle.
Recommend separate BookingTransaction and BookingEvidence models with explicit request, hold, waitlist, confirmed, cancellation-pending and reconciliation states.
Calendar creation is a downstream projection and must not independently prove provider confirmation.
External mutations need stable operation/idempotency identities, duplicate webhook suppression, out-of-order reconciliation and human recovery for ambiguous outcomes.
Reschedules require immutable old/new lineage; material term changes require fresh user approval.
evidence_basis: Google Calendar creation and attendee-response semantics
Square Bookings API idempotency, versions and webhook delivery semantics
BenefitFlow beta models.py and workflow.py gap analysis
requested_disposition: Manager/reviewer classify findings and reconcile R3/R5/R6/R10 dependencies before any Primary integration.
authority_note: Specialist evidence only; this message does not modify accepted project state.
